items.text: Creative quality and messaging drive 49% of a brand's sales lift from advertising, more than targeting, reach, and media buying combined.
items.source: Nielsen Catalina Solutions, "Five Keys to Advertising Effectiveness"
items.suggestedCaption: Creative quality and messaging drive 49% of a brand's sales lift from advertising, more than targeting, reach, and media buying combined. (Source: Nielsen Catalina Solutions, "Five Keys to Advertising Effectiveness")

items.text: If it doesn't sell, it isn't creative.
items.author: David Ogilvy
items.suggestedCaption: "If it doesn't sell, it isn't creative." — David Ogilvy

items.text: For digital campaigns specifically, creative drives 56% of sales lift, compared to just 30% from media factors like targeting and reach.
items.suggestedCaption: For digital campaigns specifically, creative drives 56% of sales lift, compared to just 30% from media factors like targeting and reach. (Source: Nielsen Catalina Solutions)

items.text: AI doesn't replace creative judgment. It multiplies how many ideas you can test before you commit a media budget to one.
items.author: Spaceback
items.suggestedCaption: "AI doesn't replace creative judgment. It multiplies how many ideas you can test before you commit a media budget to one." — Spaceback

items.text: High-quality creative delivers up to 4.7x higher ROI than average creative.
items.source: WARC & Kantar, "Top-quality creative quadruples your profit"
items.suggestedCaption: High-quality creative delivers up to 4.7x higher ROI than average creative. (Source: WARC & Kantar, "Top-quality creative quadruples your profit")

items.text: The algorithm doesn't get tired of your audience. Your creative does.
items.author: Spaceback
items.suggestedCaption: "The algorithm doesn't get tired of your audience. Your creative does." — Spaceback

items.text: In 2006, creative accounted for 65% of advertising's sales lift. Media's influence has since doubled, and creative still outweighs it at 49%.
